high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "sadiesink_." The post features a person standing on a balcony with a cityscape in the background. The individual has light brown hair and is wearing a white t-shirt, blue jeans, and a long necklace with a black and gold design. They also have earphones around their neck. The person is posing with one hand resting on the railing and the other hand placed on the ledge. The setting appears to be an urban environment, as seen from the buildings and streets visible through the railing.
